programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Painting The Town
programme.desc: Folk artist Eric Dowdle travels across North America, meeting the local people, sampling food, learning about culture and touring local attractions in an effort to determine what makes each place unique. Each episode culminates in the creation of a piece of colorful folk art that symbolizes the place Dowdle has visited.

programme.title: World Tour
programme.desc: In the thrilling travel show “World Tour,” viewers embark on captivating adventures to the most exotic corners of the planet. From the charming streets of Paris to the breathtaking landscapes of New Zealand, each episode offers new amazing places, cultures, and traditions. With inspiring stories from locals and unexpected discoveries, “World Tour” immerses viewers in the exciting world of travel and adventure.

programme.title: Discover The World: Algarve, To The End Of The World
programme.desc: Embark on a mesmerizing journey through Portugal's untamed beauty, from Cabo de São Vicente to the Algarve cliffs. Explore history, towns, cities, and pristine beaches, uncovering the essence of this southwestern gem.

programme.title: Discover The World: Ria Formosa, The Ever-Changing Estuary Of Portugal
programme.desc: This is a fascinating journey that takes us to discover Ria Formosa, a unique region in the south of the nation. This spectacular national park is known for its lagoons, islands and wetlands, as well as its extraordinary biodiversity.

programme.title: Discover The World: Saint Lucia, Geological Uniqueness
programme.desc: A rugged territory comprising several islands, glacier-carved valleys, and deep fjords, alongside rainforests, mountain ranges, and a semi-aridagricultural region. We'll explore Vancouver, Seattle, and venture to the ocean to meet whales.

programme.title: Discover The World: Dominica , The Caribbean Jungle
programme.desc: Dominica, the least visited Caribbean island, captivates with its untouched wilderness, so pristine that it could be recognized as Columbus left it.

programme.title: Discover The World: Pacific Northwest - Washington State & British Columbia
programme.desc: A rugged territory comprising several islands, glacier-carved valleys, and deep fjords, alongside rainforests, mountain ranges, and a semi-arid agricultural region. We'll explore Vancouver, Seattle, and venture to the ocean to meet whales.

programme.title: Discover The World: Australia The Fossil Continent
programme.desc: Down under lies Australia, an island-continent as vast as the United States, sculpted by wind, water, and weather into magnificent rock formations and desolating beauty.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Party Barges, River Races, Country Boys & Very Old Wine
programme.desc: Come discover the Kentucky River, including majestic Boone Creek, as well as the historic lock and museum at Boonesboro. Kentucky’s first 255 mile river race gets rained but craft brews abound with featured stories including the Emmy Nominated story on Country Boy Brewing as well as North America’s First Vineyard wines.
